report.tagline: The world's largest hotel booking site, run by Booking Holdings, known for testing almost every change on real users.
report.simpleSummary: Booking.com is where millions of people book hotels, apartments and holiday homes around the world. You search a city, see prices, photos and reviews, and often book with free cancellation and pay at the hotel. Hotels pay Booking.com a commission, usually around 15%, on each stay. The company is famous for running thousands of small experiments to find out which page design makes people book more.

overview.whatItDoes: Booking.com is an online travel agency (OTA) that lists hotels, apartments, homes and resorts, plus flights, car rentals and attractions. Guests book in the app or site and either pay at the property or pay Booking upfront. Properties pay a commission on each stay.
howItWorks: Hotels and hosts list rooms with prices and availability through the Extranet or a channel manager.
Guests search, filter by price, rating and free cancellation, and book.
Booking.com earns a commission, typically 15% to 18%, either taken from the guest's upfront payment or invoiced to the hotel later.
Genius loyalty gives repeat guests 10% to 20% discounts and perks that hotels fund.
Hotels can pay extra commission through the Visibility Booster and Preferred Partner programmes to rank higher.
overview.valueProposition: For travellers: the widest choice of stays anywhere in the world, with free cancellation on many rooms and trusted reviews. For hotels: global demand they could never reach alone, paid only when a guest books.

businessModel.summary: Booking.com makes money by taking a commission from hotels on each stay, either as an agency (hotel pays later) or as a merchant (Booking takes payment and passes it on). It also earns from flights, cars, ads and payments.

revenueStreams.detail: Hotel collects payment and pays Booking about 15% to 18% later.
Booking takes guest payment upfront and keeps its cut; now about 70% of bookings.
Hotels pay extra commission for higher ranking.
Fees on 21 million flight tickets in Q3 2026 and on car rentals.
Payment fees and currency conversion margins on merchant bookings.

businessModel.pricing: Free for travellers. Hotels pay commission, usually about 15% in most markets and higher for extra visibility. Genius discounts are funded by hotels.
costDrivers: Performance marketing, especially Google ads, the largest cost
businessModel.unitEconomics: Rough example. A guest books 3 nights at €150, so €450. Booking.com keeps about 15%, so €67. If the guest came from a Google ad, Booking might pay €20 to €30 for that click. Payment and support add a few euros. So a booking from Google earns maybe €30, while a repeat booking through the app with no ad earns nearly the full €67. That is why Genius, the app and direct traffic matter so much.

howTheyGetUsers: Google search ads and hotel ads, where Booking.com is one of the biggest spenders
Hotels themselves sending guests to manage bookings in the app
whatBringsUsersBack: Genius discounts that grow with each stay
growth.moat: Booking.com has the largest set of hotels worldwide, about 30 years of reviews, and the money to outbid smaller rivals on Google ads. Its culture of constant testing makes the site convert better than rivals, so each ad click earns more. That lets it pay more for ads, which brings in more guests and more hotels.

competitors.name: MakeMyTrip

competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Booking.com owns the bookings and supply, but Google controls much of its traffic.

northStar.metric: Room nights stayed (booked and not cancelled)
northStar.why: Room nights stayed show that guests found and used a place to sleep, which is the core value, and it is the main volume number Booking itself reports. Using stayed, not just booked, nights is a better north star because cancellations are common.

guardrailMetrics: Customer complaints about fees and disclosures
Marketing spend as a share of revenue
strengths: Largest supply of hotels in the world
World-famous experimentation culture that steadily improves conversion
Very profitable, with $2.7 billion net income in one quarter
Shift to merchant payments gives more control and payment income
weaknesses: Depends heavily on Google for traffic
Hotels resent high commissions and parity pressure
Urgency messages and fee displays are often called dark patterns
Customer support complaints, especially when hotels cancel
risks: EU Digital Markets Act names Booking a gatekeeper, banning rules that stop hotels offering cheaper prices elsewhere
FTC action in the US over disclosures, fees and billing, with a $900 million revenue reduction booked in Q3 2026
AI assistants could book travel directly and cut OTAs out
Middle East conflict and weak international demand
userComplaints: Hotel says it has no record of the booking or is overbooked
Fees and city taxes not clear until checkout or arrival
Hard to reach support and slow refunds
Hotels complain about commission and fake-looking reviews

improvementIdeas.idea: Show the final price including all taxes on search results everywhere
improvementIdeas.problem: Guests feel misled by fees, and regulators are acting.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Higher trust and lower legal risk.

improvementIdeas.idea: Arrival guarantee: if the hotel cannot honour the booking, Booking.com rebooks nearby and pays the difference
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Repeat rate after a hotel-side issue

improvementIdeas.idea: Grow app and Genius bookings in India with UPI and local deals
improvementIdeas.problem: Google ads make each booking expensive.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Share of bookings from direct and app traffic

improvementIdeas.idea: Test removing pressure messages in one market
improvementIdeas.problem: Urgency messages hurt trust and attract regulators.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Learn the real trade-off between conversion and trust.

improvementIdeas.idea: Simple commission dashboard showing hotels their return on each programme
improvementIdeas.problem: Hotels feel pushed into paying more without seeing results.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Partner churn and programme renewal rate

pmLessons: Run experiments to settle debates. Booking.com tests changes on real users instead of trusting opinions.
Optimising only for short-term conversion can harm trust. Watch guardrails like complaints and repeat rate.
Paid traffic is rented. Loyalty programmes and apps turn rented customers into owned ones.
Small conversion gains matter a lot at huge scale: 1% more bookings on 1.2 billion nights is millions of nights.

interviewQuestions.question: Booking.com runs about 1,000 tests at once. How would you design an A/B test for a new free cancellation label?
interviewQuestions.hint: State the hypothesis, pick the primary metric (stayed bookings, not just bookings), add guardrails (cancellations, complaints), size the sample and decide in advance how to judge results.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you reduce Booking.com's dependence on Google?
interviewQuestions.hint: List ways to win direct traffic (app, Genius, Connected Trip, AI planner), estimate savings per booking, track direct share.

interviewQuestions.question: Compare Booking.com and MakeMyTrip for an Indian traveller going abroad.
interviewQuestions.hint: Compare supply, price, payments, support and loyalty. Pick where each wins and why.

interviewQuestions.question: An A/B test raises bookings 2% but cancellations 5%. Do you ship it?
interviewQuestions.hint: Compute net stayed nights and revenue, check hotel impact and trust, consider segment-level shipping.

interviewQuestions.question: How should Booking.com respond to AI assistants that plan whole trips?
interviewQuestions.hint: Consider partnering, building its own AI Trip Planner, and owning supply and payments. Define success metrics.

assumptions: Booking Holdings numbers include Agoda, Priceline, KAYAK and OpenTable; Booking.com is assumed to be most of the total.
Commission of 15% to 18% is a typical reported range, not a published rate for every market.
The '1,000 experiments at a time' figure is from older public case studies and may have changed.
Google ad cost per booking in the example is an estimate.
